read.thesis: Record Q4 with 81.2% combined ratio and 23.5% core ROTE, but management flags growing commercial competition and property rate cuts of 4.6% in North America, offset by mix and expense-led margin gains.

triggers.label: NA property rates down 4.6%
triggers.quote: Property pricing was down 1.5% with rates down 4.6%, partially offset by exposure of 3.3%.

triggers.label: Market more competitive quarter-by-quarter
triggers.quote: the market globally is in transition and growing incrementally more competitive quarter-by-quarter, particularly large account property admitted in E&S and upper middle market.

triggers.label: Large account/E&S property rates down >13.5%
triggers.quote: property pricing was down over 13.5% in large account business and E&S

triggers.label: NA casualty pricing up 8.5%
triggers.quote: Casualty pricing in North America was up 8.5%, with rates up 7.6% and exposure up 0.8%.

triggers.label: D&O public rate firming first in many quarters
triggers.quote: North America public D&O seeing a slight rate increase for the first time in several quarters.

guidance.quote: We expect adjusted net investment income in the first quarter of 2026 to be between $1.81 billion to $1.84 billion.
We expect our annual core operating effective tax rate for 2026 to be in the range of 19.5% to 20%.

guidance.metric: 2026 EPS and tangible book value growth
guidance.quote: we're confident in our ability to generate for the year strong growth in operating earnings and double-digit growth in EPS and tangible book value

red_flags.label: Commercial property rate cuts accelerating
red_flags.quote: property pricing was down over 13.5% in large account business and E&S

red_flags.label: Management says market more competitive each quarter

evasions.topic: Sustaining North America commercial margins in 2026
evasions.quote: I don't give forward guidance, as you know.
We don't break out the margin by business.
That's a worksheet question. I think we ought to take off-line
